'''Models Yml''' is the pure definition file that overrides provider definitions
and per-model settings WITHOUT writing a plugin or any custom code. It is loaded
at startup from <code>{OMNI_DIR}/config/models.yml</code>; an absent or empty file
means zero behavior change, and a malformed file fails startup with a clear error.

== Overview ==

The file is the reference for three situations:

* A provider plugin's hardcoded <code>default_model.allowed_values</code> is
  wrong or missing new models.
* You want a provider that has no plugin at all; the builtin
  <code>chat_completions</code> / <code>anthropic_messages</code> support is enough.
* You want per-provider or per-model token budgets, <code>max_tokens</code>,
  <code>api_mode</code>, <code>supports_reasoning</code>, base URL or API key
  without touching plugin config.

{{OmniFact
|what=config/models.yml provider and model overrides

}}

== Format ==

<pre>
providers:
  deepseek:
    plugin: true
    models: ["deepseek-flash", "deepseek-v4-pro"]
  my_provider_01:
    plugin: false
    api_mode: "chat_completions"
    supports_reasoning: true
    default_base_url: "http://noop-provider:9090/v1"
    refresh_url: "https://api.deepseek.com/v1/models"
    default_model: "test-model-1"
    api_key: "$secret:MY_SECRET"
    models: ["my_model_01", "my_model_02", "my_model_03"]
    model_config:
      my_model_02:
        api_mode: "anthropic"
        supports_reasoning: false
        token_budget_soft: 200000
        token_budget_hard: 1000000
        max_tokens: 32000
        max_tokens_on_truncation: 128000
</pre>

Values written as <code>$secret:NAME</code> or <code>$env:VAR</code> are resolved
through the credential store, never written literally; see [[Secrets Store]].

== Semantics ==

* <code>providers.&lt;name&gt;.plugin</code> selects the transport: <code>true</code>
  or a plugin name uses the provider plugin, <code>false</code> uses builtin
  support. A name that matches an existing provider plugin overrides it.
* <code>providers.&lt;name&gt;.models</code> replaces
  <code>default_model.allowed_values</code> in every selector.
* Provider-level fields override the plugin manifest or config.
* <code>model_config.&lt;model&gt;</code> overrides per model, with the highest
  precedence.

== Budget fallback chain ==

For each of the soft and hard token budgets independently:

# <code>model_config.&lt;model&gt;</code> budget in models.yml;
# else the provider-level budget;
# else the global settings budget (<code>prompt_token_budget_soft</code> default
# 100000, <code>prompt_token_budget_hard</code> default 500000).

The agent resolves the effective values and passes them to the prompt plugin's
compact-messages tool; the prompt plugin never reads models.yml itself.

== API and refresh flow ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Operation !! Method + path
|-
| Read the parsed file || <code>GET /api/models</code>
|-
| Validate and atomically write || <code>PUT /api/models</code>
|}

The dashboard refresh button fetches the remote models from <code>refresh_url</code>
and upserts the models.yml entry through the API. An entry that is absent is
created with <code>plugin: true</code> plus the fetched list; an entry that is
present has ONLY its <code>models</code> updated, every other field byte-identical.
Plugin manifests, config schemas and caches are never touched.

== DeepSeek "v4.1 flash" ==

There is no <code>deepseek-v4.1-flash</code> model name: the provider rejects it.
<code>GET https://api.deepseek.com/v1/models</code> returns
<code>deepseek-flash</code> and <code>deepseek-v4-pro</code>, and a direct call
with <code>deepseek-flash</code> answered correctly, so '''deepseek-flash IS
v4.1 flash'''. The models list and <code>default_model</code> were corrected in
the authoritative code-less provider source.

== Provider resolution ==

<code>models_yaml::resolve_provider_metadata</code> is the single resolver both
consumers use. The effective list is enabled provider plugins '''unioned with'''
models.yml, deduplicated, with models.yml winning on the same id. A merged entry
whose plugin is missing or disabled fails with HTTP 400 naming the provider id and
reason, never a silent fallback.
